items.headline: Stephen Curry Linked to Shock Celtics Trade, Warriors Insider Pushes Back
items.summary: Speculation is swirling around a potential blockbuster trade that would send Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry to the Boston Celtics. Reports suggest Celtics President of Basketball Operations Brad Stevens has already contacted the Warriors to discuss a deal. However, a Warriors insider quickly took to social media to firmly deny the rumors, stating, 'This has not happened and Steph Curry will not be traded.' Curry, who has one year left on his contract, will be eligible for an extension later this month, fueling further discussion about his future.

items.headline: Jeremy Sochan Joins Portland Trail Blazers
items.summary: Polish forward Jeremy Sochan has reportedly agreed to a one-year contract with the Portland Trail Blazers. Sochan, fresh off an NBA championship win with the New York Knicks, will be looking to make an impact in Portland after previously playing for the San Antonio Spurs.

items.headline: Warriors Retain Key Guards Melton and Payton II
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors have re-signed free agent guards De'Anthony Melton and Gary Payton II. These moves bring back 10 of the 12 players with the most playing time from last season, as Golden State aims to bounce back from a 37-45 season that saw them miss the playoffs. Payton II signed a one-year veteran minimum deal worth $3.9 million.

items.headline: Kevin Durant Trade Rumors Persist, Karl-Anthony Towns Speculation
items.summary: Kevin Durant trade rumors continue to circulate, with a speculative proposal suggesting the Houston Rockets could acquire Karl-Anthony Towns from the Knicks for the veteran forward. While purely speculative, the move would see Houston target a younger All-Star in Towns, who is several years Durant's junior.

items.headline: Golden State Warriors Crowned 2026 NBA Summer League Champions
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors captured the 2026 Las Vegas Summer League Championship on July 19, defeating the Memphis Grizzlies 94-90 in a thrilling comeback victory. Rookie sensation Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 21 points and 10 rebounds, earning Championship Game MVP honors. Memphis' third overall pick, Cameron Boozer, contributed 19 points and eight rebounds in the loss.

items.headline: Russell Westbrook Remains Unsigned in Free Agency
items.summary: Veteran guard Russell Westbrook, 37, is still a notable name on the free-agent market. While capable of producing numbers (15.2 PPG, 6.7 APG, 5.4 RPG last season with the Kings), an NBA scout expressed strong reservations, stating, 'I wouldn't touch him in a million years,' citing concerns about his shooting, defensive commitment, and fit within a system.

items.headline: Pat Zipfel Joins Weber State Coaching Staff
items.summary: Longtime NBA assistant Pat Zipfel has been named the associate head coach of the Weber State Wildcats men's basketball program, effective August 1st. Zipfel brings over 24 years of NBA experience, including recent stints as an advance scout for the Philadelphia 76ers and assistant coaching roles with several franchises.

items.headline: Kyle Lowry and Garrett Temple Announce Retirements
items.summary: Two veteran NBA players have officially retired from professional basketball. Kyle Lowry, an NBA champion with the Raptors, announced his retirement on July 7, 2026, after a 20-season career. Garrett Temple, who played for 12 teams over 17 years, retired on July 4, 2026, and has since been hired as an assistant coach for the Dallas Mavericks.

items.headline: 2026-27 NBA Schedule Release Anticipated Mid-August
items.summary: Fans eagerly awaiting the 2026-27 NBA schedule can expect the full release around mid-August. The regular season is slated to tip off in October 2026, with the fourth edition of the NBA Cup tournament scheduled from October 30 to December 11, 2026.
